c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Set the cycle flavor (shotgun | compare | refine). NOTE: this cycle ran pre-engine under superpowers:brainstorming (2026-07-12, same session); it is materialized here retroactively at engine adoption, per the user's directive to switch frameworks mid-flow. Framing: goal interrogation (fantasy league format, success bar, timeline) + repo stocktake, then a 3-option compare of roadmap shapes.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor=compare. Cycle ran in-session pre-engine under superpowers:brainstorming; materialized retroactively at framework switch (user directive). Starting questions covered: the itch (win the fantasy league, live 2026), for whom (Tommy, mid-pack 4 seasons), what done feels like (single submittable ranked list + interrogable explainer + weekly gap-to-front scoreboard), what exists (stocktake), kill condition (channel bets honestly nulled).

q1.title: What is the goal, the bar, and the clock — and which roadmap shape serves it?
q1.imperative: Interrogate the human one question at a time (league format; success criterion; live-2026 vs 2027 build; weekly loop shape; timing appetite), then compare 2-3 roadmap shapes recommendation-led.
q1.finding: League = ~20 humans, delta-sum+bingo on race top-10, picks pre-quali. Bar = WIN the league (winners ~674/season; Tommy ~766; model ~853 → need ~7.5 pts/race). Live 2026, Belgium R10 (Jul 19) gets a real prediction. Loop = co-pilot: single ranked list on inattentive weeks. Compare of 3 shapes → two-track push chosen, user-modified: no merge freeze (expect Thu/Fri mergeable), gold-retrain-with-2026 is informational regression case only, learned-not-hardcoded heuristics principle.

x1.title: Excursion (research): four-explorer repo stocktake — what exists, what's planned, what's WIP?
x1.imperative: One named question per explorer: (a) evo predictor current state + honest quality numbers; (b) physics pipeline deliverables today vs planned; (c) issue/roadmap landscape + governing spec sequencing; (d) working-tree WIP provenance and loss risk. Dispatched as 4 background Explore subagents (pre-engine; results verified against workbooks/DB where load-bearing).
x1.finding: Stocktake verdicts (scoped to repo state 2026-07-12): evo = sampled 3-stage runtime + 12 latent-power NN modules, race stages at persistence ceiling, all headroom in quali (0.74 vs ~0.81); benchmark 'human 2697' = sum of league WINNERS not Tommy (verified arithmetic). Physics = measurement machinery complete (8-season quali capability store, wear run 5, ephemeris v1 needing regen); C4 #513 FP-fits unbuilt = predict-time gap; zero physics->evo imports (bridge #513->#450 unbuilt). DB stale 2 races (R8/R9 missing). WIP = damage-clock campaign; 17 untracked scripts at loss risk; f1_data_2023.db 16MB->2GB needs deliberate call. NOT tested: whether physics features actually lift the quali head (that IS the #450 A/B).

consolidation.summary: Compare cycle consolidated: two-track push (Track 1 Belgium race-week loop; Track 2 point engines: league decomposition, DNF hazard, #513->#450, ephemeris regen/#589, RegulationEra) with user modifications (no merge freeze; retrain informational; learned-not-hardcoded). Options A/C culled with reasons retained on board. Open threads carried to board: decomposition channel weights, DNF model shape, race-week command seam, explainer design, tournament-variance lineup strategy, sprint-weekend evidence shape, 2026 train-vs-recalibrate.
